description:
What home-owners with a mortgage pay each month: repayments in 11 bands from under $300 to $4,000 or more, and the median monthly repayment, for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 7,200 suburbs and localities and 498 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/mortgage-repayments`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_mortgaged_households, mortgage_0_299_count, mortgage_0_299_pct, mortgage_300_449_count, mortgage_300_449_pct, mortgage_450_599_count, mortgage_450_599_pct, mortgage_600_799_count, mortgage_600_799_pct, mortgage_800_999_count, mortgage_800_999_pct, mortgage_1000_1399_count, mortgage_1000_1399_pct, mortgage_1400_1799_count, mortgage_1400_1799_pct, mortgage_1800_2399_count, mortgage_1800_2399_pct, mortgage_2400_2999_count, mortgage_2400_2999_pct, mortgage_3000_3999_count, mortgage_3000_3999_pct, mortgage_4000_plus_count, mortgage_4000_plus_pct, mortgage_not_stated_count, mortgage_not_stated_pct, median_mortgage_monthly. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
